title: Per-player game logs for 2026-11-17, read from the stored official game pages

provenance.capture: data/raw/session-e3d25abc/gamepages/2026-11-17/ (gzipped by scripts/capture_official_e3d25abc.py on a GitHub Actions runner; SHA-256 re-verified here)
provenance.second_source: the official gamebook PDF of the same game, archived content-addressed beside it

rule: One row per (game, player). A player who did not appear is a row with played=false and null stats, never a dropped row. Minutes/points/rebounds/assists are the official page's own values; per team the parsed points must equal the printed score and the parsed minutes must equal 240:00 (+25:00 per OT) or the run reports it under problems.

coverage.note: `names_on_report_not_found_in_any_gamebook` counts report names with no row on that day's game page, which is the normal shape for an Out designation - the page prints only the game's active/inactive list. It is a coverage statement, not a discrepancy.

source_name: NBA.com official game page for each game (www.nba.com/game/…), stored gzip-compressed and SHA-256-content-addressed by scripts/capture_official_e3d25abc.py; the league's own gamebook PDF of the same game is archived beside it as the second official read

minutes_check.note: The official page rounds each player's MM:SS to the second, so a team's per-player minutes need not sum to exactly 240:00; the bound is half a second per player who appeared. The printed team minute total on the same page is published per team in each game's minutes_check block, and the residual is reported, not corrected.
